name: Mike T.
text: Having Forever Lights installed was a breeze thanks to their professional team and 50' boom lift. Our home looks stunning year-round and we haven't touched a ladder since!

name: Sarah K.
text: We used to spend an entire weekend putting up Christmas lights. Now it takes literally 10 seconds on my phone. The lights match our soffit perfectly — neighbours constantly ask who did them.

name: James & Laura P.
text: Worth every penny. We change the colours for every holiday — Christmas red and green, orange for Halloween, pink for Valentine's. The whole family loves it.

name: Dave R.
text: The install team was incredibly professional. They matched the colour to our white fascia exactly. From the street you can barely see the track — until the lights come on at night!

name: Angela M.
text: I was skeptical about the price at first, but the financing made it easy. Two years in and zero maintenance. My home is the best-looking one on the block every single season.
